title: Word Break
statement: Given a string `s` and a list of words `word_dict`, return `true` if `s` can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words. The same word may be reused.
starter_code:
def word_break(s, word_dict):
    # dp[i] means s[:i] can be segmented
    dp = [False] * (len(s) + 1)
    dp[0] = True
    return False
